thread:
Maya: Hey team — prepping the SparrowLabs customer spot. We recorded the interview yesterday; raw audio + transcript are uploaded. Need to lock: quotes, consent form, embargo date, and webinar tie-in. Who can own quote clearance with legal?

Jonas: Uploaded raw audio + transcript here: https://drive.redwood/sparrow/raw-audio-171850. Key pull quote I highlighted: 'Redwood cut inference cost by 62% for our production workload.' Not sure Sparrow will want that exact phrasing.

Priya: Drafted hero Q&A + three candidate pull quotes and two tweet threads. Dropped the doc here: https://docs.redwood/sparrow/draft. Pull quotes: 1) cost reduction, 2) latency improvements, 3) simpler deploy.

Maya: Pinned Priya's draft. Also: Sales wants a lead-handling form if we publish — auto-create trial leads and tag "sparrow-cs" in CRM. @Elliot can you coordinate?

Elliot: Yep — I can add a lightweight lead form and demo flow. Two CTA options: "Start a trial" or "Request a cost audit" — which should go in the blog and webinar CTAs?

Maya: Let's prepare both. Legal, can you confirm the necessary consent language for the transcript and audio clips? Need signed release from Sparrow before we publish or use clips in ads.

Legal Team: Quick heads up — for any percentage claims we need either (a) an attestation from Sparrow with methodology or (b) internal verification data. Also require a signed release on letterhead with explicit permission to use quotes and short clips, plus an embargo date if requested.

Jonas: Noted. I'll pull the metric logs used to compute the 62% figure and add a short methodology blurb to the doc.

Priya: Legal wanted softer language. Suggested redline: change 'cut inference cost by 62%' -> 'reduced inference spend by ~60% on their typical LLM workloads'. Thoughts?

Maya: That's better. Less absolute. Also ask Sparrow for approval of the exact phrasing. I'll DM Amy at Sparrow for a confirmation and the signed release.

Jonas: Edited the transcript to flag timestamps for the best soundbites: 00:45, 03:12, 07:05. Produced 3x 15s clips and 1x 60s clip. Link to mp3s: https://assets.redwood/sparrow/clips.zip

Priya: For the blog: hero quote + 3 sidebars + a short technical appendix (methodology & config). For the webinar: 20-min customer segment + 10-min live Q&A. Can we lock a webinar date in the same week as publish?

Elliot: Sales wants the webinar scheduled the week after publish to drive demo signups. Proposed publish Monday 2024-06-24, webinar Wednesday 2024-06-26. Is that feasible?

Maya: Calendar check — proposed embargo release: Friday 2024-06-21 EOD for internal preview, public publish Monday 2024-06-24. Legal sign-off needed by Friday 10am PT.

Legal Team: We'll review the draft and methodology tonight. Also sending a release template now — contracts-bot will ping when Sparrow returns signed doc.

contracts-bot: Sparrow_License_and_Release_v1.pdf uploaded to /legal/sparrow/ — awaiting signature.

Priya: Minor editorial note from Legal: prefer the phrase 'customer spotlight' instead of 'case study' in external headlines for now. Also, remove any superlatives like 'best' without substantiation.

Jonas: I've attached logs and the short methodology note to the draft doc. If Sparrow confirms the metric, we can keep the ~60% phrasing.

Maya: Quick operational asks: 1) Sales lead form (Elliot), 2) Signed release (Legal), 3) Final quote copy (Priya), 4) Asset pack (Jonas). If anyone else is blocking, speak now.

Elliot: Sales form ready for review — added field: 'use-case vertical' + 'inference throughput' to help routing.

Priya: I'll prepare two CTA variants and update the draft by EOD tomorrow.

Legal Team: We redlined the quote language and requested the supporting metric. If Sparrow doesn't supply a signed attestation, change will be required to remove the exact percentage.

Maya: Update — Amy at Sparrow replied; she can sign the release and shared a doc confirming the 62% reduction measured across their S2 production models over a 90-day period. She asked for a 48-hour embargo after sign-off for internal comms.

Jonas: Great — can we get the attestation PDF from Amy into /legal/sparrow?

Maya: I'll ask and upload when received. Also scheduling: if we get sign-off by Fri 10am, we'll publish Monday and run webinar the next week.

contracts-bot: Sparrow_attestation_1718520000.pdf uploaded to /legal/sparrow (signed).

Priya: With attestation in place, Legal approves the revised phrasing: 'reduced inference spend by 62% for SparrowLabs' — they recommended adding the measurement window in the appendix.

Elliot: Sales confirms lead-flow mapping and demo scheduling integration.

Maya: Final check — if no objections to the final quote copy by Friday 10am PT, we'll lock assets and schedule publish. @all please react with :thumbsup: if you approve.

Jonas: :thumbsup:

Priya: :thumbsup:

Elliot: :thumbsup:

Legal Team: :thumbsup:

Maya: Thanks everyone. I'll send the signed release and final publish checklist once everything is locked.

(End thread)
